name: 84103 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84103 (Salt Lake Cty) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84103 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84103 (Salt Lake Cty) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
